title: Senior Salesforce CPQ Developer
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant (with CPQ Expertise)

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Duration: 6+ months

Need to support PST timings

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant with strong expertise in Salesforce CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) to design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions that streamline sales processes and enhance customer experience. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimize business workflows, drive automation, and enable data-driven sales operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end implementation and enhancement of Salesforce Sales Cloud and CPQ solutions.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, translating them into scalable Salesforce configurations.
  • Design and customize Salesforce Sales Cloud functionalities including Leads, Opportunities, Accounts, Contacts, Products, Price Books, Quotes, and Contracts.
  • Implement and maintain CPQ functionalities – product configuration, pricing rules, discount structures, and quote-to-order processes.
  • Develop custom workflows, approval processes, validation rules, and automation using Flows, Process Builder, and Apex (if required).
  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems (ERP, billing, or marketing platforms) using APIs and middleware tools.
  • Conduct system testing, UAT, and user training to ensure seamless adoption.
  • Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot issues, and recommend system optimizations.
  • Stay updated on Salesforce releases and CPQ enhancements to recommend best practices and continuous improvements.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Salesforce Sales Cloud implementation and configuration.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ (Steel Brick) configuration and administration.
  • Strong understanding of Sales Cloud architecture, data model, and standard Salesforce features.
  • Expertise in Product, Pricing, Discount, and Quoting processes within CPQ.
  • Experience with Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and integration tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, etc.) preferred.
  • Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud Consultant, and CPQ Specialist certifications are highly desirable.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Analista de FIDC Sr
description:
Somos uma empresa completa que oferece soluções financeiras para todo ecossistema de combustível, através de: Conta Digital PF, Conta Digital PJ, Corretora de Seguros, Cartão Benefícios, Cartão de Crédito, Clube de Vantagens, Folha de Pagamento, Cobrança, Asset, FIDC, entre outros. Nossa missão é ser a principal fonte de soluções financeiras eficientes para postos de combustível, refinarias, distribuição e transportadoras de combustível, seus colaboradores e clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar a rotina operacional dos FIDCs , incluindo entradas, cessões, cotistas, amortizações e remunerações, garantindo aderência às políticas internas e regulamentos dos fundos;
  • Realizar conciliações financeiras e contábeis das operações do fundo, assegurando a integridade das informações entre os sistemas internos, administradores e custodiante;
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance dos FIDCs , como carteira, inadimplência, concentração de cedentes, nível de subordinação e fluxo de pagamentos;
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas de Produtos e Crédito , apoiando o desenvolvimento e a viabilização de novos produtos financeiros que dependam de funding via FIDC , avaliando impactos operacionais, jurídicos e regulatórios;
  • Interagir com prestadores externos (administrador, custodiante, auditor, agente de cobrança, gestor e consultor especializado), assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das informações enviadas;
  • Analisar contratos e documentos de cessão de crédito , conferindo critérios de elegibilidade e aderência às regras de enquadramento do fundo;
  • Participar da estruturação de novos FIDCs , apoiando na modelagem de fluxos, controles e políticas de crédito, risco e governança;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas, externas e processos de diligência junto a órgãos reguladores, investidores e instituições financeiras parceiras;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e operacionais com indicadores de desempenho, rentabilidade e risco;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas da CVM, Bacen e ANBIMA , bem como as políticas internas de compliance e controles internos;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Risco, Tesouraria, Contabilidade, Jurídico e Tecnologia , assegurando integração e consistência das informações do fundo.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas ;
  • Experiência sólida em operações de FIDC , preferencialmente em gestoras, securitizadoras, fintechs, bancos ou administradoras de fundos ;
  • Conhecimento prático em estruturação, acompanhamento e controle de FIDCs , incluindo regras de cessão, fluxo de caixa e gestão de garantias;
  • Domínio de Excel avançado e ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, Tableau, etc.);
  • Conhecimento das normas CVM 356, 555, 175 e demais regulamentações aplicáveis a fundos estruturados;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de fundos e cessões de crédito;
  • Raciocínio analítico, atenção a detalhes e alta capacidade de organização.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em FIDCs vinculados a meios de pagamento, crédito corporativo ou recebíveis de cartões ;
  • Conhecimento em estruturação de fundos, precificação de cotas e modelagem de fluxo de caixa ;
  • Experiência em interação com áreas de produtos e modelagem de soluções financeiras baseadas em funding estruturado;
  • Conhecimento em regulação de instituições de pagamento e open finance .

Perfil Comportamental

  • Perfil analítico, detalhista e comprometido com precisão e prazos ;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e assertiva com áreas internas e parceiros externos;
  • Proatividade e senso de dono , com foco em melhorias contínuas e mitigação de riscos;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambiente dinâmico, tecnológico e regulado .

Nossa escala é presencial de segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48 na região da Henrique Schaumann próximo ao metrô Oscar Freire

title: Consultora de BI I Vaga Afirmativa para Mulheres
description:

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior - People Analytics
description:
Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e se colocando à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz mais limpa.

Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior – People Analytics para fazer parte do nosso time de Soluções de RH.

Atividades:

Estruturar a área de dados de RH, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e integração de dados.

Desenvolver análises e indicadores que conectem a estratégia de pessoas ao negócio, apoiando a liderança na tomada de decisão.

Atuar como referência técnica desde a arquitetura de dados até a entrega de insights práticos e aplicáveis, propondo melhorias e apoiando a sustentação a cultura de dados para gestão de pessoas.

  • Mapear, integrar, organizar e modelar os múltiplos dados de diferentes sistemas de RH (Folha, Ponto, Engajamento, Performance, R&S, etc);
  • Estruturar fluxos de coleta, modelagem, armazenamento e disponibilidade dos dados em repositórios organizados (Data Lake), garantindo a consistência entre fontes e confiabilidade desses dados;
  • Construir e refinar dashboards e relatórios de indicadores chave associados a temática de gestão de pessoas;
  • Garantir governança, padronização e consistência das bases de dados, definindo critérios e regras para indicadores, validando fontes, documentando metodologias e revisando rotinas de atualização;
  • Conduzir análises descritivas e preditivas para antecipar riscos e oportunidades em temas de pessoas;
  • Preparar relatórios e apresentações executivas que apoiem fóruns de decisão;
  • Apoiar a definição de métricas estratégicas (KPIs e OKRs de People) alinhadas aos objetivos da companhia;
  • Fornecer insumos analíticos para projetos transversais de RH (remuneração, cultura, engajamento, T&D, planejamento de pessoas);
  • Apoiar lideranças de RH e do negócio como parceiro de dados, conectando análises às necessidades reais de gestão;
  • Atuar como referência em dados de RH, sendo fonte confiável para a formação da cultura de dados na empresa.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Tecnologia e Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação em Data Analytics, Business Intelligence ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel avançado e ferramentas de modelagem e visualização de dados (Power BI, Alteryx e/ou equivalentes);
  • SQL básico para manipulação de dados (desejável Python ou R);
  • Boa compreensão dos processos de RH (recrutamento, performance, folha de pagamento, benefícios, engajamento, desenvolvimento etc.);
  • Inglês intermediário.

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento básico sobre integração de sistemas para coleta e entrega de dados;
  • Conhecimento em estatística aplicada e análise preditiva;
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação de estrutura de dados, preferencialmente em RH.

Tipo de contratação: Efetivo - CLT

Localidade: Morumbi - Região Sul - Modelo híbrido

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição ou Restaurante na Unidade, conforme seu local de atuação e modalidade de contratação.
  • Vale Alimentação, que dá uma baita ajuda nas despesas de casa!
  • Vale Transporte.
  • Plano médico - para você cuidar da sua saúde e da sua família (dependentes diretos).
  • Plano odontológico - para você manter aquele sorrisão!
  • Gympass – para você cuidar da sua saúde física e ter muita energia!
  • Temos Crédito Consignado: parcelas descontadas direto na folha de pagamento e juros mais baixos.
  • Temos PR (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Temos Vale Gás mensal – uma exclusividade do nosso negócio;

  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 (cento e oitenta dias) para você cuidar da pessoa mais importante da sua vida!

Venha energizar vidas com a gente!

title: Analista de Planejamento de Exportação Pleno
description:

title: Supervisor (a) de Manutenção Mecânica
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Our Mission

RoadFlex’s mission is to modernize financial services for the underserved fleet and logistics industry. The logistics industry is the backbone of the US economy. However, the financial infrastructure on which they run is broken. These are underserved industries where the existing financial and payment tools are difficult to use, outdated and saddled with shady fee structures.

We are changing that. RoadFlex believes that the hardworking men and women in this sector deserve better. With RoadFlex, customers can rely on the timely movement of capital for our supply chains to function efficiently. We build financial tools and payment products for drivers and fleet managers. We offer them world-class customer service that work with and around the unique constraints of their daily lives. If you would like to join our mission of helping the people manning the backbone of the US economy, let’s talk!

RoadFlex offers fleet customers an advanced fleet card and expense management solution, powered by AI technology. Our solution provides fleet customers with valuable insights and data- driven decision-making capabilities. With real-time visibility and control, our program enhances fleet operations and performance management, leading to significant cost savings and improved driver retention. Additionally, our solution includes fuel risk management features that effectively prevent fuel fraud and unauthorized purchases. By combining our solution with our exceptional support and customer success programs, we ensure our clients have an excellent fleet expense management experience while achieving a strong return on investment (ROI).

About the role

The ideal candidate for the position of Business Development Representative (BDR) at RoadFlex is a high-performing, team-oriented individual who is eager to advance their sales career. In this role, you will support our sales teams by driving demand for our solution. Your primary responsibilities will include outreach, cold calling potential customers and generating qualified opportunities for our Business Development Representative (BDR) and helping with demos.

You will also be responsible for qualifying inbound leads and scheduling introductory meetings and demos with prospective customers. BDRs play a crucial role in our company's growth, providing valuable experience in interacting with clients from various industries and locations. This position offers a challenging, dynamic, and rewarding work environment with ample opportunities for career growth.

What you’ll do

  • Focus heavily on proactive prospecting (cold calling, industry associations, email campaigns, marketing campaigns, referrals, LinkedIn, etc.) into the assigned territory/region to generate new opportunities for RoadFlex’s Sales Account Executives (AEs)
  • Collaborate closely with your assigned AE to create a targeted list of prospective accounts while working with cross-functional teams to prospect new accounts strategically
  • Research accounts, identify key players, and generate the interest of potential customers, positioning RoadFlex’s unique value proposition
  • Follow up, educate, and qualify inbound leads to create sales-ready meetings and opportunities for our Sales Account Executives
  • Leverage outbound cold-calling and outreach to target accounts across different industries
  • Understand customer needs & effectively communicate how RoadFlex’s unique solution will help drive success for their organization
  • Provide accurate, thorough discovery call handoffs to the appropriate AE and become a trusted and credible source of leads for the sales team
  • Work closely with the Marketing team to drive continuous improvement in lead quality, conversion rates, and pipeline generation through messaging and process improvements
  • Use and maintain RoadFlex’s Sales CRM & other tools to provide metrics on leads, subsequent opportunities, and pipeline development
  • Regularly perform against individual monthly and/or quarterly quota and KPI targets, pipeline development, conversion rates, and qualified opportunities.

Professional Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1-3 years of sales development, business development, or prospecting enterprise organizations, c-suite or executive teams
  • Experience in prospecting and setting meetings in the fleet or telematics industry is a plus
  • Experience with giving demos to prospective clientele
  • Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
  • Strong skills in self-sourcing opportunities (outreach) and the ability to appropriately qualify inbound leads
  • Works well with cross-functional teams and performs in a fast-paced, fun, sales-oriented environment
  • Eagerness to achieve goals and quotas
  • Experience working with enterprise sales and CRM tools; LinkedIn, Apollo, and other prospecting tools experience is a plus
  • Must be self-directed, a quick learner, energetic, and an enthusiastic team player with a desire to pursue a career in Sales
  • Challenger-sales methodology skills are a plus
  • This is a remote position

Compensation

We offer a competitive and attractive compensation package that includes base salary + variable compensation based on experience and performance, and a comprehensive employee benefits package. We value teamwork, innovation, and productivity, which will foster an exciting work environment.

Our Background

RoadFlex was founded by serial technology entrepreneurs. Our founders have backgrounds in leading operations at Fortune 500 companies, working on cutting-edge financial products for top financial institutions, and growing technology startups from 5 to 500 employees. With over $20 million in funding, we are backed by some of the industry's most influential technology entrepreneurs and investors. Our partners are just as passionate as we are about modernizing the fleet payments industry.

RoadFlex is backed by the best top-tier VCs and the Founders/CEOs of multi-billion dollar tech companies including Pipe, Flexport, Hippo Insurance, Shippo, Product Hunt, Digits, amongst others.

We have years of runway to grow and support you on your journey. We're looking for customer and product-obsessed entrepreneurs who want to work with a dynamic fast-moving team and build the roadmap for the RoadFlex rocket ship. If this is you, we are super excited to meet you and learn more.

title: Especialista em Análise de Riscos e Dados (Risk Analytics)
description:
Sobre a área

A área de Risk Analytics atua como um elo entre Engenharia de Dados e as áreas de Negócios da Seguradora. Nosso propósito é transformar dados em inteligência analítica para apoiar decisões estratégicas em Subscrição, Crédito, Operações, Mercado e Sinistros .

Além disso, será responsável pela visualização e comunicação analítica dos resultados, construindo dashboards em Power BI ou Tableau e traduzindo análises técnicas em insights claros para a diretoria e áreas de negócio.

Terá interação constante com as áreas internas da seguradora, apoiando com dados, indicadores e análises que ajudem a compreender os detratores de risco e identificar oportunidades de melhoria e crescimento.

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil

about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.

job context

and purpose

Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.

Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients

Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met

job

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent presentation skills used in delivering solutions to executive-level clients
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas
  • Strong drive and commitment to delivering outstanding results
  • Have the ability to provide value with the use of analytics to help achieve the account’s objectives and the client’s initiatives.
  • Ability to create meaningful insights and metrics that aligned to business priorities and objectives
  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.
  • Ability to write Intermediate SQL scripts
  • Experience in data pipeline creation, quality improvement and analysis to provide teams with actionable insights, informing strategy, impact and investments.
  • Experience with analytics tools.
  • Extensive experience in technical client service (i.e. consulting experience).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail and a well-organized, structured approach to work.

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Job Title: Data Quality Analyst

Purpose:

The Data Quality Analyst is responsible for auditing and testing enterprise applications with a focus on backend ETL (Extract, Transform & Load) processes and other software modules related to the creation of data warehouse reporting instruments , ensuring high-quality and reliable information. This role also involves creating ad-hoc queries to extract information from reporting sources as requested by business areas.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Follow established quality assurance standards and processes .
  • Determine and implement methods, flows, and procedures to improve QA and business processes.
  • Create and document test scripts to audit data integrity on an ongoing basis.
  • Test newly developed applications by creating test scenarios and verifying compliance with business requirements.
  • Analyze and resolve application and data issues as they arise.
  • Document production processes and objects for better understanding across IT and business users.
  • Handle ad-hoc data warehouse queries for end users as needed.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related business discipline from an accredited institution; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Data Quality Assurance , preferably in data warehousing or reporting environments .
  • At least 2 years of QA testing experience , ideally in data integrity assessment .
  • Preferably 2+ years of experience in the travel industry .
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.

Technical Skills:

  • SQL and PL/SQL (Oracle platform preferred).
  • Strong understanding of ETL processes (Extract, Transform, Load).
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and architectures.
  • Experience creating and executing test scripts for data validation.
  • Strong data analysis and troubleshooting skills with large datasets.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (tables, indexes, triggers, etc.).
  • Familiarity with reporting/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, OBIEE, Cognos).
  • Intermediate English level (B2) – strong written and verbal communication required.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in team environments .
  • Capable of managing multiple projects and shifting priorities effectively.

title: Supervisor de manutenção predial
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO:

Supervisiona e realiza trabalhos técnicos e mecânicos que garantem que os ambientes internos e externos dos prédios, terrenos, áreas comuns e comodidades da comunidade atendam aos padrões da Empresa em relação à limpeza, aparência, segurança e funcionalidade geral.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Auxilia e executa ordens de serviço geradas por solicitações dos moradores, bem como manutenção de rotina na comunidade, diagnosticando a origem ou causa do defeito ou problema e realizando os reparos de acordo com as políticas, procedimentos, normas de segurança e exigências do código estabelecidos.

• Supervisiona e conclui o processo de preparação (“make-ready”) das unidades desocupadas para locação e novos moradores, realizando a inspeção pré-desocupação, criando uma lista de manutenção necessária, agendando fornecedores e prestadores de serviço conforme necessário, adquirindo os materiais e suprimentos necessários, realizando todas as tarefas de manutenção e inspecionando o trabalho concluído.

• Desenvolve padrões para a limpeza e aparência geral das áreas externas da comunidade, comodidades, fachadas dos edifícios, interiores das unidades prontas para locação, corredores, calçadas, placas, escritório de locação, áreas centrais de lixo, estacionamentos e outras construções e áreas comuns, garantindo que reflitam a alta qualidade da comunidade e os padrões da Greystar.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por outros membros da equipe de manutenção para avaliar a eficácia das políticas e procedimentos e desenvolver planos de ação corretiva conforme necessário.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por empreiteiros, fornecedores e outros prestadores de serviços para verificar se os serviços, materiais e mão de obra atendem aos padrões de qualidade, escopo e especificações exigidas.

• Mantém inventário adequado de peças de reposição e materiais de manutenção, trabalhando com o Gerente da Comunidade para encomendar suprimentos e ferramentas conforme necessário, respeitando os limites orçamentários.

• Executa os procedimentos de manutenção preventiva mensalmente conforme descrito no Manual de Políticas e Procedimentos.

• Apoia programas de economia e controle de despesas consertando, sempre que possível, ao invés de substituir peças, evitando desperdício de materiais e suprimentos e utilizando ferramentas e equipamentos corretamente.

• Realiza reuniões regulares de segurança da Greystar, garante que todas as fichas MSDS estejam atualizadas e acessíveis, e mantém-se informado sobre todas as exigências e legislações de segurança da OSHA e outras entidades para garantir a conformidade da comunidade.

CONHECIMENTOS BÁSICOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem fornecer suas próprias ferramentas manuais, salvo quando proibido pela legislação estadual, e devem ter conhecimento e habilidades no uso e manutenção seguros de ferramentas manuais, elétricas, equipamentos mecânicos e dispositivos de medição.

• Capacidade demonstrada de aplicar princípios de raciocínio lógico para definir e corrigir problemas.

• Proficiência em atendimento ao cliente e habilidades de comunicação interpessoal para interagir eficazmente com moradores, clientes, colegas de equipe e outros contatos profissionais, respondendo com cortesia a perguntas e solicitações e mantendo a calma ao lidar com problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz para representar a gestão da empresa em funções de apoio, atuar como primeiro ponto de contato para colegas de equipe internos e visitantes externos, e responder a perguntas relacionadas às políticas operacionais do departamento.

• Proficiência demonstrada em programas de internet, processamento de texto, planilhas e gerenciamento de banco de dados para manter registros e desenvolver informações para uso do gestor. (Experiência com sistemas de gestão imobiliária é preferida.)

• Capacidade de operar máquinas básicas de escritório, como copiadoras, fax, calculadoras, máquinas de selos postais e sistemas telefônicos com várias linhas.

• Habilidades matemáticas necessárias para somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir números, decimais e frações para revisar e preencher documentos financeiros, administrativos e legais.

• Ensino Médio completo, GED ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.

LICENÇAS OU CERTIFICAÇÕES EXIGIDAS:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem possuir todas as certificações exigidas pelas jurisdições estaduais e locais.

VIAGENS / EXIGÊNCIAS FÍSICAS:

• Os membros da equipe trabalham em ambiente de escritório ou remoto. Nenhuma exigência física especial é necessária.

• Viagens raras ou ocasionais podem ser exigidas para participar de reuniões de negócios, treinamentos ou outras situações necessárias para o cumprimento de algumas ou todas as responsabilidades diárias deste cargo.

Sobre a Greystar

A Greystar é uma empresa global líder, totalmente integrada, do setor imobiliário, oferecendo expertise em gestão de propriedades, gestão de investimentos, desenvolvimento e serviços de construção nos setores de habitação para locação de padrão institucional, logística e ciências da vida. Com sede em Charleston, Carolina do Sul, a Greystar gerencia e opera mais de US$ 290 bilhões em imóveis em 247 mercados globalmente, com escritórios em toda a América do Norte, Europa, América do Sul e região da Ásia-Pacífico. A Greystar é a maior operadora de apartamentos nos Estados Unidos, administra mais de 857.400 unidades/leitos em todo o mundo e possui uma robusta plataforma institucional de gestão de investimentos, com mais de US$ 76 bilhões em ativos sob gestão, incluindo mais de US$ 34 bilhões em ativos em desenvolvimento. A Greystar foi fundada por Bob Faith em 1993 com o objetivo de se tornar uma prestadora de serviços de classe mundial no setor imobiliário residencial para locação. Para saber mais, acesse .

description:

title: Senior Technical Manager - Fixed Networks & Infrastructure
description:
About This Role

We're seeking an exceptional Senior Technical Manager who will architect and orchestrate mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure that powers millions of connections across Latin America. This is your opportunity to drive technological innovation, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of fixed network solutions.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership

  • Architect and deploy carrier-grade fixed network solutions across fiber optics, GPON/EPON, SDN/NFV, and bearer network ecosystems
  • Master end-to-end bearer networks: optical transport (DWDM/OTN), metro aggregation, IP/MPLS backbone, and microwave transmission
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams (15+ engineers) driving innovation and operational excellence
  • Drive technical strategy for large-scale network transformation projects aligned with business objectives

Operational Excellence

  • Execute logical deployment strategies including provisioning, service activation, and zero-touch deployment frameworks
  • Command Tier 3/4 technical support operations with root cause analysis and incident elimination protocols
  • Optimize warranty lifecycle and spares inventory ensuring <99% equipment availability
  • Delivery measurable improvements: 99.99%+ uptime, 40%+ MTTR reduction, enhanced operational efficiency

Technical Mastery

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.

Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations

Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies
  • Multi-vendor platforms: ZTE, Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, Cisco optical/routing equipment

Deployment & Operations

  • Complex cutover management and phased rollout strategies with zero service disruption
  • Multi-tier support framework design and escalation matrix implementation
  • Data-driven spares management and predictive maintenance programs
  • Vendor negotiation and RMA cycle management
  • Process automation and provisioning timeline reduction

Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to identify and develop high-potential talent, assessing how candidates think and solve problems under pressure
  • Building high-performing teams in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Strategic mindset balancing operational needs with long-term architectural vision
  • Cross-functional collaboration across deployment, support, procurement, and vendor management

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)

Plus/Nice to Have

  • Wireless network experience (4G/5G RAN, microwave backhaul, small cells, DAS)
  • Wireless-wireline convergence architectures
  • Spectrum management and RF planning knowledge

Why Join Us

✅ Strategic Influence: Direct access to executive leadership shaping company direction

✅ Technical Autonomy: Select technologies, design architectures, and optimize operations

✅ Operational Impact: Transform deployment, support, and maintenance organization-wide

✅ Market Leadership: Partner with tier-1 carriers on

✅ Career Growth: Clear pathway to progress inside the company

✅ Competitive Package: Industry-leading compensation aligned with performance outcomes

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI

Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments

title: CONSULTOR(A) CIENTISTA DADOS II
description:
QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

DADOS:

GS: 17

Local: Jacareí / SP (Hibrido)

Inscrições até: 06/11/2025

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Criar modelos e ensembles de modelos usando técnicas combinadas de Machine Learning, estatística e otimização para solução de problemas de negócio;
  • Criar ferramentas com o foco no aumento da produtividade do time em atividades críticas de Machine Learning, como pré-processamento, criação dos modelos e deploy;
  • Interpretar resultados e gerar visualizações e conclusões de análises que construam histórias relevantes e conjunto de ações para a organização;
  • Construir forte relacionamento com diversas áreas internas a empresa de modo a garantir entendimento compreensivo dos requisitos do negócio;
  • Trabalhar em modelo ágil e de forma colaborativa dentro de squads;
  • Orientar o time com metodologia, ferramenta e conhecimento para soluções de problemas com Machine Learning;
  • Definir melhores práticas de Gestão de Dados e Gestão do Código para garantindo pontualidade e rigor nas soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Fazer a conexão entre problemas de negócio e oportunidades analíticas, sendo capaz de estimar benefícios para o negócio;
  • Ser capaz de comunicar de forma profissional e objetivo os benefícios e alavancas dos produtos digitais para especialistas do negócio em vários níveis de senioridade;
  • Liderar tecnicamente um dos domínios de ciência de dados (Otimização, Visão Computacional, NLP, etc) entre as tribos, definindo requisitos, tecnologias e melhores práticas;
  • Construir e gerenciar análises de múltiplas bases de dados de grande volume (ex. base de transações, vendedores, clientes) usando diversas ferramentas técnicas (SQL, R, Python, Excel) para criar análises fundadas com qualidade e rigor;
  • Desenvolver modelos de otimização linear inteira, inteira mista, algoritmos evolutivos modelos utilizando técnicas de Inteligência Artificial para solução de problemas de negócio;
  • Definir o frame do problema, suas features e a melhor forma de criar modelos para soluções de problemas;
  • Criar modelos na forma de micro serviços ou APIs em serviços de cloud ou on-premise;
  • Definir junto com times de TI requisitos de Arquitetura, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir robustez e automação nas soluções desenvolvidas.

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Sólida experiencia na área de ciência de dados – Modelagem e/ou projetos de otimização;
  • Experiencia com métodos analíticos avançados (ex. Machine Learning/ Deep Learning / Otimização, entre outros);
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias e linguagens de programação como Python, R e SQL;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura e serviços de cloud, como: Containers, Virtural Machines, bancos de dados no-sql, integração;
  • Experiência em programação e uso de linguagem como Python e/ou R Experiência em ferramentas de programação como Python para publicar modelos na forma de micro serviços ou APIs seja na nuvem ou on-premises;
  • Experiência no uso em ferramentas de colaboração e versionamento de códigos;
  • Experiência em esteiras de CI/CD (Azure pipelines, Github Actions, etc);
  • Experiência em modelos de otimização exatos e/ou heurísticas na solução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento técnico: estatística avançada e análises e conceitos financeiros avançados;
  • Cinco anos de experiência de trabalho com análises, modelagem preditiva e interpretação de dados ou similares na área;
  • Será feito um teste na forma de case ou prova online para que o candidato demonstre habilidades na área
  • Vivencia no segmento industrial será considerado um diferencial;
  • Desejável especialização ou pós graduação na área de machine learning, estatística ou pesquisa operacional;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

SOBRE A VAGA:

  • Atenção! Apenas aplicações pelo Google Forms serão consideradas.

Responsabilidades

  • Implementar features em  React Native + TypeScript do início ao fim.
  • Definir a  arquitetura do app (navegação, estado, dados, cache/offline).
  • Integrar  APIs REST/GraphQL/WebSocket com tratamento de erros e timeouts.
  • Cuidar de  performance : tempo de abertura, fluidez, memória e bateria.
  • Escrever  testes (unitários e e2e) e revisar PRs.
  • Preparar e operar  releases (CI/CD, versões, ambientes, feature flags) .
  • Publicar e manter o app na  App Store e Play Store .
  • Tratar  segurança e privacidade : armazenamento local, tokens e permissões.
  • Instrumentar  métricas, logs e crash reports e agir sobre elas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com  design e PM para definir escopo, critérios de aceite e prazos.

Competências Técnicas

  • React Native e TypeScript sólidos (componentes, hooks, acessibilidade, animações básicas).
  • Gerenciamento de estado e dados (cache, paginação, updates otimistas, sync em background).
  • Deep links, notificações push, permissões, uploads/downloads de mídia, temas e i18n.
  • Integração de APIs com retries, backoff e versionamento.
  • Testes com Jest/RTL e e2e (Detox/Maestro); lint/format; documentação objetiva.
  • CI/CD: build, assinatura, canais (internal/beta/prod), OTA quando aplicável.
  • Noções de backend em TypeScript para desenhar/consumir APIs e logs.
  • Comunicação clara, capacidade de quebrar problemas em etapas e atenção aos detalhes.

Diferenciais 

  • Experiência com  apps em grande escala e rollouts graduais .
  • Pagamentos/assinaturas in-app .
  • Otimização de listas grandes e mídia (compressão, pré-carregamento).
  • Acessibilidade avançada (VoiceOver/TalkBack).
  • Segurança extra (obfuscação leve, certificate pinning).

Perfil que buscamos

  • Mentalidade de  resolução de problemas (não apenas execução).
  • Gosto por  aprender e evoluir rápido .
  • Comunicação clara e vontade de crescer com o time.

Modelo de contratação

  • Remuneração compatível com nível técnico e experiência +  bônus por performance
  • 100% remoto

title: Senior Asset & Material Management Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Responsible for the end-to-end management of company assets and materials, including inventory control, maintenance, recycling, disposal, and system operations, ensuring asset security, compliance, and efficient utilization.

Job Responsibilities:

  1. Manage the inbound and outbound flow of materials; verify that material name codes, quantities, and specifications match system records and purchase orders; establish asset cards in a timely manner to ensure alignment between physical items, records, and system entries.
  2. Review and oversee the recycling of materials and the optimal allocation of idle resources.
  3. Track material maintenance activities, assign maintenance personnel, monitor maintenance progress, and collect and analyze maintenance data.
  4. Review and handle scrapped materials and commodities according to company procedures; ensure proper disposal of such items.
  5. Provide guidance and supervision on departmental material and asset management; ensure the implementation of asset management responsibilities at the individual level; manage recovery and compensation in cases of material damage or loss.

Requirements:

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above; at least 5 years of experience in asset management or administrative management is preferred.
  2. Familiar with asset management processes; proficient in asset management systems and computer operations, especially MS Office (Word, Excel, etc.).
  3. Solid knowledge of asset management, including asset definition, classification, management methods, and understanding of the asset lifecycle concept.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
Business Operations Associate

São Paulo, Brazil

payment solutions and access to capital. With our payment orchestration solution, we integrate multiple

payment methods to our subacquirer, helping businesses increase transaction approvals and improve

their sales by up to 22%, reduce costs and drive sustainable growth. Our mission is to be the go-to

partner for companies looking to expand efficiently, offering technology and personalized support in an

all-in-one platform.

This is a PJ hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in our office on Av Brigadeiro Faria Lima 1912.

About the role and team:

We are looking for a Business Operations Associate to join our dynamic team.

You will have the opportunity to drive the success of businesses in Brazil and play a critical role in

ensuring smooth operational processes, providing exceptional customer support, and fostering strong

relationships with our clients. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and driven by

problem-solving. Our operations and customer success teams are the tip of the spear of our business,

with agile thinking and excellent communication to drive positive change for our customers.

addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive customer experience.

quickly, delivering an exceptional customer experience that conveys trust and reliability.

information.

title: Product Designer - Sênior
description:
PRODUCT DESIGNER

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Product Designer, você será responsável por conduzir processos de Discovery e Design de Experiência, transformando problemas complexos em soluções intuitivas, consistentes e centradas no usuário. Sua missão será conectar estratégia, dados e usabilidade para desenhar produtos digitais que gerem impacto real para o negócio e para as pessoas.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir processos de Discovery, aplicando metodologias como benchmark, canvas, pesquisas com usuários, testes de usabilidade, análises heurísticas e hierarquia da informação para propor e definir jornadas consistentes;
  • Criar o layout de fluxos de navegação e comunicações a serem apresentados no site, desenhar wireframes, protótipos interativos e interfaces visuais responsiva;
  • Garantir consistência visual, de informação e de usabilidade em todos os produtos digitais;
  • Participar de agendas colaborativas com times de produto, tecnologia e dados, alinhando objetivos estratégicos;
  • Contribuir para a evolução e manutenção do design system da empresa.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência comprovada como UX/UI Designer, com portfólio relevante;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em Design Thinking, Lean UX e metodologias centradas no usuário;
  • Familiaridade com princípios de acessibilidade e design inclusivo;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e traduzir insights em soluções de design;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em São Paulo/SP.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Já tiver atuado com metodologias ágeis;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciadores de tarefas;
  • Já tiver atuado em consultoria ou prestação de serviços;
  • Tiver perfil analítico, organizado e propositivo, com autogestão e foco em qualidade das entregas.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.

This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.

We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.

Who are we?

BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .

What you will do:

  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.

What we expect from you:

  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.

What We Offer

  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.

Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You’ll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

title: Strategic Projects Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others.

We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

Vammo is hiring a strategic, high-performing leader to join our Special Projects & Strategy team - a small, elite group working directly with executives and founders - to solve the most complex and high-impact challenges in the company. You’ll drive cross-functional initiatives that shape Vammo’s growth trajectory - from fleet and asset optimization to financial modeling, new business models, partnerships, and operational scaling.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, loves tackling hard problems, and moves seamlessly between data, strategy, and execution. You will be deeply embedded across teams - working hand-in-hand with Fleet, Charging, Maintenance, Sales, Software, and Hardware - and expected to think like an owner.

You will be based in São Paulo and will report directly to executives at Vammo

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute high-impact strategic projects that directly influence Vammo’s operational and financial performance.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify bottlenecks, design solutions, and drive implementation.
  • Build analytical frameworks and dashboards to inform decision-making across the company.
  • Develop business cases, models, and strategic plans for new initiatives — from asset financing structures to expansion playbooks.
  • Own key cross-functional workstreams (e.g., pricing, network expansion, strategic partnerships).
  • Translate insights into clear recommendations and operational action.
  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team on fundraising, board materials, and strategic communications.
  • Build and mentor small, high-performing project teams as the function scales.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of total experience, ideally including:

2–4 years at a top-tier management consulting firm (BCG, Bain, McKinsey, etc.)

3–4 years in a high-growth startup or operating role where you owned key projects end-to-end.

  • Proven track record of leading and executing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills — comfortable in Excel, PowerPoint, and with messy data.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize ruthlessly, and move fast.
  • Strong business judgment and curiosity about how hardware, logistics, and software intersect.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish or Chinese a plus.
  • Based in São Paulo, with willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Strong alignment with Vammo’s mission and values.

Benefits

  • A front-row seat at one of Latin America’s most ambitious hardware and climate tech startups, backed by world-class investors.
  • A mission-driven environment where every decision contributes to decarbonizing mobility and empowering low-income workers.
  • Exposure to all areas of the business — you’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team on company-defining decisions.
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you can handle — and grow faster than anywhere else.
  • Competitive compensation and equity package.
  • Health insurance and benefits.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and purpose-driven team that loves to build real things in the real world.

Vammo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or any other protected factor.

title: QHSE Coordinator
description:
About the Company

Munksjö is a leading international manufacturer of decor paper for surface finishing on wood-based panels.

Our mission is to create comfortable living and working environments , always driven by innovation, quality, and environmental responsibility .

We develop and deliver innovative and customized decorative paper solutions , which, after further processing, are used in the production of furniture, laminate flooring, and surface materials for both indoor and outdoor applications.

At Munksjö, we believe that taking responsibility for the future of our planet is a priority — sustainability is at the core of everything we do.

About the Role

We are seeking a QHSE Coordinator with proven focus on environmental management to join our team in Caieiras-SP.

This professional will be responsible for ensuring the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of QHSE systems and practices, with a strong emphasis on environmental compliance and performance .

The role plays a key part in promoting a sustainability-driven culture , ensuring alignment with environmental legislation, corporate goals, and best practices .

Responsibilities

Environmental Management

  • Plan, implement, and monitor sustainability and environmental management programs.
  • Track and analyze environmental KPIs (emissions, effluents, waste, energy, and water consumption).
  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, and licenses.
  • Conduct and manage internal and external audits.
  • Lead environmental impact mitigation and carbon neutrality projects.
  • Develop environmental awareness and engagement campaigns.
  • Oversee supplier and partner compliance with environmental requirements.
  • Lead strategic environmental initiatives (e.g., zero landfill, waste segregation).
  • Support occupational health and safety programs and accident prevention initiatives.
  • Monitor HSE indicators and propose corrective/preventive actions.
  • Maintain and enhance the Integrated Management System (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
  • Coordinate QHSE training and awareness activities.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and zero accidents.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Degree in Environmental Engineering, Production Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree in Environmental Management, Sustainability, or related areas (preferred).
  • Fluent English (mandatory).

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in QHSE, with proven focus on environmental management.
  • Experience in multinational organizations, interacting with corporate and external stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of leading environmental projects.

Technical Knowledge:

  • Brazilian environmental legislation.
  • Waste, effluent, and emission management.

Founded in 2003 by Chad Wekelo, Actualize Consulting emerged from a vision to create a niche firm where every team member is valued as a collaborator rather than just an employee. Drawing from his Big Four experience, Chad, alongside partners Matt Seu and COO, Kerry Wekelo; built a company specializing in Capital Markets, Mortgage and Fixed Income, and Treasury Operations. Their leadership fostered a culture rooted in gratitude, trust, and growth. Kerry's personal journey led to the development of wellness-based principles that transformed the company's culture. This commitment to employee well being and mutual respect has earned Actualize numerous accolades, including recognition as a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and Great Place to Work Certified. Beyond internal culture, Actualize is dedicated to diversity, inclusion, and community impact, and a belief that a people-first approach drives both personal fulfillment and professional excellence.

You will work closely with CFOs, Treasurers, and finance teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, from system implementation and integration to technical accounting guidance for complex treasury transactions.
